coverage_limits: This is a complete six-axis independent source assessment of the exact frozen B-08/I08 finals and their declared lineage. It is not a production certification, an exhaustive audit of all vendor source files, an exhaustive market search, or an assessment of any other case/arm history.

All complete narrative artifacts and all seven source indexes were read. Source-map entries and governing sections/symbols were compared. Retained code captures were read at relevant symbols or independently re-retrieved at the same release; not every line of every retained source file was audited.

Primary current docs/pricing/main snapshots are observations at recorded access times; tagged ERPNext/Snipe code and releases are version anchors. Mutable docs are not silently treated as capabilities of an unnamed installed version.
No candidate was edited or repaired. No application/server/browser/witness was started. Independent witnesses in this assessment are source/control-flow counterexamples, not runtime executions.

All material findings identify concrete consequential errors/omissions/over-rejections within the brief. Runtime absence, externally unspecified district choices and full implementation details are not themselves grounds for failure.
Native/candidate T3 delivery, billing and hidden tool/provider usage remain separate and null when unobserved. Artifact existence and hashes establish scope, not scientific quality.
